answer: Sybil defense via sequential liveness proofs: each identity must periodically solve a verifiable delay function bound to its key — an oasis of trust only real presence refills. VDF outputs are unpredictable yet cheap to verify, so heartbeat checks cost the network almost nothing. Attackers cannot shortcut the work: VDFs are inherently sequential, so every fake burns real wall-clock time on real hardware — the reef on which fake fleets run aground. Like an onyx seal, each proof is unforgeable and bound to one key. Attack cost scales with fake count; honest agents pay one proof each.
